SELECT s.first_name, s.middle_name, s.last_name FROM students s WHERE s.student_id IN (SELECT se.student_id FROM student_enrolment se INNER JOIN transcripts t ON t.transcript_id = se.student_enrolment_id ORDER BY t.transcript_date ASC, se.student_id ASC LIMIT 1)
